<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="sq">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>FundJava Albania — Aktivitete &amp; Aventura</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400;1,600&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --green:#1b4332;--green2:#2d6a4f;--green3:#40916c;
  --sand:#f0ebe3;--sand2:#e8e0d4;--sand3:#d6cfc4;
  --gold:#b5873d;--gold2:#e2a84b;
  --cream:#faf8f4;--white:#fff;
  --text:#1a1713;--text2:#4a4540;--text3:#8a8480;
  --border:#ddd8d0;--r:14px;
  --red:#c0392b;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;background:var(--cream);color:var(--text);line-height:1.7;font-size:16px;font-weight:300}

/* ── LOGIN OVERLAY ── */
#login-overlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a1f14 0%,#1b4332 50%,#0d2b1d 100%);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:1rem;
}
#login-overlay.hidden{display:none}

.login-box{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  border-radius:24px;
  padding:3rem 2.8rem;
  width:100%;max-width:440px;
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  box-shadow:0 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}

.login-logo{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:2.2rem;font-weight:600;
  color:#fff;text-align:center;
  margin-bottom:0.3rem;
}
.login-logo span{color:var(--gold2)}
.login-tagline{text-align:center;font-size:0.82rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.45);letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:2.5rem}

.login-tabs{display:flex;gap:0;margin-bottom:2rem;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}
.ltab{flex:1;padding:0.6rem;text-align:center;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);background:transparent;border:none;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;transition:all 0.2s}
.ltab.active{background:var(--gold);color:#fff}

.login-label{font-size:0.7rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.2px;margin-bottom:0.4rem;display:block}
.login-input{
  width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  border-radius:9px;padding:0.75rem 1rem;
  font-size:0.92rem;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;
  color:#fff;outline:none;margin-bottom:1.1rem;
  transition:border-color 0.2s;
}
.login-input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.25)}
.login-input:focus{border-color:var(--gold2)}
.login-input.error{border-color:var(--red)}

.login-err{
  background:rgba(192,57,43,0.15);
  border:1px solid rgba(192,57,43,0.35);
  border-radius:8px;padding:0.7rem 1rem;
  font-size:0.82rem;color:#ff8a7a;
  margin-bottom:1rem;display:none;
}
.login-err.show{display:block}

.login-ok{
  background:rgba(27,67,50,0.4);
  border:1px solid rgba(64,145,108,0.4);
  border-radius:8px;padding:0.7rem 1rem;
  font-size:0.82rem;color:#6ee7b7;
  margin-bottom:1rem;display:none;
}
.login-ok.show{display:block}

.login-btn{
  width:100%;background:var(--gold);color:#fff;border:none;
  padding:0.9rem;border-radius:9px;font-size:0.95rem;
  font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;
  transition:all 0.2s;margin-top:0.3rem;
}
.login-btn:hover{background:#9a6f2e;transform:translateY(-1px)}

.login-contact{
  margin-top:2rem;padding-top:1.5rem;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  text-align:center;
}
.login-contact p{font-size:0.78rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35);margin-bottom:0.7rem}
.login-contact a{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);text-decoration:none;
  font-size:0.82rem;transition:color 0.2s;margin:0 0.3rem;
}
.login-contact a:hover{color:var(--gold2)}

/* Password strength */
.pw-strength{height:3px;border-radius:2px;margin-top:-0.8rem;margin-bottom:1rem;transition:all 0.3s;background:#333}
.pw-weak{background:var(--red)}
.pw-medium{background:var(--gold)}
.pw-strong{background:#40916c}
.pw-hint{font-size:0.7rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35);margin-top:-0.7rem;margin-bottom:0.9rem}

/* User badge in nav */
.user-badge{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;
  background:rgba(27,67,50,0.1);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:6px;padding:0.35rem 0.8rem;
  font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--green);cursor:pointer;
  transition:all 0.2s;
}
.user-badge:hover{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.user-avatar{
  width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--green);color:#fff;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:600;
}

/* ── TOPBAR ── */
.topbar{background:var(--green);padding:0.5rem 2.5rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:0.8rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.75)}
.topbar a{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.9);text-decoration:none}
.topbar-right{display:flex;gap:2rem;align-items:center}
.topbar-right a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem;transition:color 0.2s}
.topbar-right a:hover{color:#fff}
.topbar-cta{background:var(--gold);color:#fff!important;padding:0.25rem 0.9rem;border-radius:4px;font-weight:500!important;font-size:0.82rem}

/* ── NAV ── */
nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:200;background:rgba(250,248,244,0.96);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 2.5rem;height:68px}
.nav-logo{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--green);text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:-0.5px}
.nav-logo span{color:var(--gold)}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:1.8rem;list-style:none;align-items:center}
.nav-links a{color:var(--text2);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.88rem;font-weight:400;transition:color 0.2s}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--green)}
.nav-phone{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;font-size:0.88rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--green);text-decoration:none;border:1.5px solid var(--green);padding:0.4rem 1rem;border-radius:6px;transition:all 0.2s}
.nav-phone:hover{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.nav-cta{background:var(--gold);color:#fff;padding:0.45rem 1.2rem;border-radius:6px;font-weight:500;font-size:0.88rem;text-decoration:none;transition:background 0.2s;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif}
.nav-cta:hover{background:#9a6f2e}

/* ── HERO ── */
.hero{position:relative;height:100vh;min-height:650px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;overflow:hidden}
.hero-left{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding:4rem 3.5rem;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d2b1d 0%,#1b4332 60%,#2d6a4f 100%);z-index:1}
.hero-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8);font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0.4rem 1rem;border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:1.5rem;width:fit-content}
.hero-left h1{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(3rem,5vw,4.5rem);font-weight:600;color:#fff;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:1.3rem}
.hero-left h1 em{color:var(--gold2);font-style:italic}
.hero-left p{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);font-size:1rem;max-width:400px;margin-bottom:2rem}
.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:0.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:#fff;padding:0.85rem 1.8rem;border-radius:var(--r);font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:500;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;text-decoration:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem}
.btn-gold:hover{background:#9a6f2e;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);padding:0.85rem 1.8rem;border-radius:var(--r);font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:400;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;text-decoration:none;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08)}
.hero-stats{display:flex;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:2.5rem;width:fit-content}
.hero-stat{padding:0.9rem 1.5rem;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)}
.hero-stat:last-child{border-right:none}
.hero-stat .n{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:600;color:#fff;line-height:1}
.hero-stat .l{font-size:0.68rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:0.2rem}
.hero-right{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero-mosaic{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;height:100%;gap:3px}
.hero-mosaic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 0.6s}
.hero-mosaic img:hover{transform:scale(1.04)}
.hero-mosaic .big{grid-row:1/3}

/* ── PHONE BAR ── */
.phone-bar{background:var(--green2);padding:1.2rem 2.5rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pb-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.8rem;color:#fff}
.pb-icon{width:38px;height:38px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1rem;flex-shrink:0}
.pb-label{font-size:0.68rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.pb-val{display:block;font-size:0.95rem;font-weight:500;color:#fff;text-decoration:none}
.pb-val:hover{color:var(--gold2)}

/* ── SEARCH ── */
.search-wrap{background:var(--white);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:1.6rem 2.5rem}
.search-inner{display:flex;gap:0.8rem;align-items:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:1200px}
.sg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.35rem;flex:1;min-width:150px}
.sg label{font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--text3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.2px}
.sg select,.sg input{border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:0.65rem 0.85rem;font-size:0.9rem;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;color:var(--text);background:var(--cream);outline:none;transition:border-color 0.2s}
.sg select:focus,.sg input:focus{border-color:var(--green3)}
.sbtn{background:var(--green);color:#fff;border:none;padding:0.7rem 1.8rem;border-radius:8px;font-size:0.9rem;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s;height:44px}
.sbtn:hover{background:var(--green2)}

/* ── LAYOUT ── */
.section{padding:5rem 2.5rem}
.s-dark{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.s-sand{background:var(--sand)}
.s-white{background:var(--white)}
.container{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.sec-tag{font-size:0.68rem;font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2.5px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:0.5rem}
.sec-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,3.5vw,3rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1.1;color:var(--text)}
.sec-title-w{color:#fff}
.sec-sub{font-size:0.93rem;color:var(--text2);margin-top:0.7rem;max-width:550px;line-height:1.7}
.sec-sub-w{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65)}
.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:3rem;gap:1rem}
.see-all{color:var(--green);font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;transition:border-color 0.2s}
.see-all:hover{border-color:var(--green)}
.see-all-w{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.75);border-bottom:1px solid transparent;text-decoration:none;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:500}
.see-all-w:hover{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5)}

/* ── PILLS ── */
.pills{display:flex;gap:0.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:2.5rem}
.pill{background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--border);color:var(--text2);padding:0.4rem 1rem;border-radius:50px;font-size:0.82rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif}
.pill:hover,.pill.active{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}

/* ── ACTIVITY CARDS ── */
.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:1.6rem}
.acard{background:var(--white);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:transform 0.3s,box-shadow 0.3s;cursor:pointer}
.acard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(27,67,50,0.12)}
.acard-img{position:relative;height:220px;overflow:hidden}
.acard-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 0.5s}
.acard:hover .acard-img img{transform:scale(1.07)}
.acard-cat{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;background:var(--white);color:var(--green);font-size:0.68rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;padding:0.3rem 0.75rem;border-radius:4px}
.acard-fav{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;width:36px;height:36px;background:var(--white);border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:transform 0.2s;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)}
.acard-fav:hover{transform:scale(1.15)}
.acard-stars{position:absolute;bottom:14px;right:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.95);border-radius:6px;padding:0.3rem 0.6rem;font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--gold)}
.acard-body{padding:1.3rem 1.4rem 1.5rem}
.acard-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:0.55rem}
.dot3{width:3px;height:3px;background:var(--border);border-radius:50%}
.acard-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:0.5rem;line-height:1.25}
.acard-desc{font-size:0.84rem;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:1rem;line-height:1.6}
.acard-tags{display:flex;gap:0.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1rem}
.atag{background:var(--sand);color:var(--text2);font-size:0.68rem;padding:0.2rem 0.6rem;border-radius:4px}
.acard-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:1rem}
.acard-price{font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--text)}
.acard-price span{color:var(--text3);font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:300}
.acard-book{background:var(--green);color:#fff;border:none;padding:0.45rem 1.1rem;border-radius:7px;font-size:0.8rem;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s}
.acard-book:hover{background:var(--green2)}

/* ── FEATURED ── */
.feat{background:var(--green);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto 5rem}
.feat-l{padding:3.5rem}
.feat-badge{display:inline-block;background:var(--gold);color:#fff;font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0.3rem 0.8rem;border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.feat-l h2{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:600;color:#fff;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:1rem}
.feat-l h2 em{color:var(--gold2);font-style:italic}
.feat-l p{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem;line-height:1.7}
.feat-pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.5rem;margin:1.2rem 0 1.8rem}
.feat-pill{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);font-size:0.78rem;padding:0.3rem 0.8rem;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)}
.feat-price{margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.feat-old{font-size:0.9rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4);text-decoration:line-through}
.feat-new{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2.2rem;color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.feat-new span{font-size:1rem;font-weight:300;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6)}
.feat-phone{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.7rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border-radius:10px;padding:0.8rem 1.2rem;margin-top:1rem;text-decoration:none;color:#fff;transition:background 0.2s;width:fit-content}
.feat-phone:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.14)}
.feat-phone .ph{font-size:1rem;font-weight:500}
.feat-phone .sub{font-size:0.72rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55)}
.feat-r{position:relative;min-height:420px}
.feat-r img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.feat-r-ov{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to right,rgba(27,67,50,0.5),transparent 50%)}
.feat-float{position:absolute;bottom:24px;right:24px;background:var(--white);border-radius:12px;padding:1rem 1.3rem;max-width:180px}

/* ── GALLERY ── */
.gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:240px 240px;gap:6px;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden}
.gallery img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 0.4s;cursor:pointer}
.gallery img:hover{transform:scale(1.04)}
.gallery .tall{grid-row:1/3}

/* ── REGIONS ── */
.reg-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:1rem}
.reg-card{position:relative;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;height:280px;cursor:pointer}
.reg-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 0.4s}
.reg-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.08)}
.reg-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(10,30,18,0.85) 35%,rgba(10,30,18,0.15))}
.reg-info{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:1.1rem;z-index:1}
.reg-info h3{color:#fff;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600}
.reg-info .acts{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);font-size:0.75rem;margin-top:0.1rem}
.reg-info .ph{color:var(--gold2);font-size:0.72rem;margin-top:0.3rem;font-weight:500}

/* ── INFO CARDS ── */
.info-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:1.2rem}
.info-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:1.5rem;display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start}
.info-icon{width:46px;height:46px;background:rgba(27,67,50,0.08);border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.3rem;flex-shrink:0}
.info-card h4{font-size:0.95rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:0.3rem}
.info-card p{font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.55}

/* ── TESTIMONIALS ── */
.test-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:1.2rem}
.tcard{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);border-radius:14px;padding:1.5rem}
.tcard-stars{color:var(--gold2);font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:0.7rem}
.tcard-text{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.75);font-size:0.87rem;line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:1rem}
.tcard-auth{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.7rem}
.tcard-av{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:0.9rem;color:#fff;font-weight:500;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif}
.tcard-name{font-size:0.85rem;color:#fff;font-weight:500}
.tcard-city{font-size:0.72rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.45)}

/* ── CONTACT ── */
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4rem;align-items:start}
.ci-list .ci{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1.3rem;padding-bottom:1.3rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.ci-list .ci:last-child{border-bottom:none;margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}
.ci-icon{width:42px;height:42px;background:rgba(27,67,50,0.08);border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.1rem;flex-shrink:0}
.ci-label{font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--text3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.ci-val{font-size:0.95rem;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;margin-top:0.1rem}
.ci-val a{color:var(--green);text-decoration:none}
.ci-val a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.ci-sub{font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--text3);margin-top:0.1rem}
.form-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;padding:2rem}
.form-card h3{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:0.4rem}
.form-card p{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0.8rem}
.fi{width:100%;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:0.7rem 0.9rem;font-size:0.9rem;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;color:var(--text);background:var(--cream);outline:none;margin-bottom:0.8rem;transition:border-color 0.2s}
.fi:focus{border-color:var(--green3)}
textarea.fi{resize:vertical;min-height:100px}
.fsub{width:100%;background:var(--green);color:#fff;border:none;padding:0.85rem;border-radius:9px;font-size:0.95rem;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s}
.fsub:hover{background:var(--green2)}

/* ── NEWSLETTER ── */
.newsletter{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--sand),var(--sand2));padding:4rem 2.5rem;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid var(--sand3)}
.newsletter h2{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2.2rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:0.8rem}
.newsletter p{color:var(--text2);font-size:0.93rem;margin-bottom:2rem}
.nl-form{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:0.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nl-form input{border:1.5px solid var(--sand3);border-radius:8px;padding:0.75rem 1.2rem;font-size:0.9rem;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;background:var(--white);width:280px;outline:none}
.nl-form input:focus{border-color:var(--green3)}

/* ── FOOTER ── */
footer{background:#0d2b1d;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);padding:4rem 2.5rem 2rem}
.footer-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.8fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:3rem;margin-bottom:3rem}
.f-logo{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:600;color:#fff;margin-bottom:0.7rem}
.f-logo span{color:var(--gold)}
.f-desc{font-size:0.85rem;line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.f-phone-box{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);border-radius:10px;padding:0.9rem 1.1rem}
.f-ph-label{font-size:0.65rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4);margin-bottom:0.25rem}
.f-ph-num{color:var(--gold2);font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;display:block}
.f-ph-num:hover{color:#fff}
.f-ph-sub{font-size:0.7rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35);margin-top:0.2rem}
footer h4{color:#fff;font-size:0.82rem;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:1rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.f-links{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.5rem}
.f-links a{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.85rem;transition:color 0.2s}
.f-links a:hover{color:#fff}
.footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);padding-top:1.5rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:0.78rem}
.socials{display:flex;gap:0.7rem}
.socials a{width:34px;height:34px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.85rem;transition:background 0.2s}
.socials a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.16);color:#fff}

/* ── MODAL ── */
.modal-ov{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,25,16,0.7);z-index:500;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:1rem}
.modal-ov.open{display:flex}
.modal{background:var(--white);border-radius:20px;max-width:520px;width:100%;padding:2.2rem;position:relative;animation:popIn 0.25s ease;max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto}
@keyframes popIn{from{transform:scale(0.93);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
.modal-x{position:absolute;top:1.2rem;right:1.2rem;background:var(--sand);border:none;border-radius:50%;width:34px;height:34px;font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--text2);transition:background 0.2s}
.modal-x:hover{background:var(--sand2)}
.modal h3{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:0.3rem}
.modal-sub{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:0.8rem}
.m-phone{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.7rem;background:var(--sand);border-radius:10px;padding:0.8rem 1rem;margin-bottom:0.7rem;text-decoration:none;color:var(--green);transition:background 0.2s}
.m-phone:hover{background:var(--sand2)}
.m-phone .ph{font-size:1rem;font-weight:500}
.m-phone .ph-sub{font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--text3)}
.m-email{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.7rem;background:var(--sand);border-radius:10px;padding:0.8rem 1rem;margin-bottom:1rem;text-decoration:none;color:var(--green);transition:background 0.2s}
.m-email:hover{background:var(--sand2)}

/* ── INFO BANNER (shown to logged-in users) ── */
.info-banner{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green),var(--green2));
  color:#fff;padding:0.9rem 2.5rem;
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;
  font-size:0.85rem;
}
.info-banner.show{display:flex}
.info-banner strong{font-weight:500}
.info-banner a{color:var(--gold2);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.info-banner a:hover{text-decoration:underline}

/* ── ANIMATIONS ── */
.fi-el{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity 0.6s ease,transform 0.6s ease}
.fi-el.vis{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;height:auto}
  .hero-right{height:300px}
  .hero-mosaic .big{grid-row:auto}
  .reg-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .feat{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2rem}
  .nav-links .nav-phone{display:none}
  .topbar{display:none}
  .gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:200px 200px 200px}
  .gallery .tall{grid-row:auto}
  .section{padding:3rem 1.2rem}
}
</style>
</head>

<section class="section s-white" id="aktivitete">

    <div class="sec-head fi-el">
      <div>
        <div class="sec-tag">Aktivitetet e Javës</div>

      <button class="pill" onclick="filterPill(this,'gastronomi')">🍽️ Gastronomi</button>
    </div>
    <div class="grid3" id="cards-grid">

        <div class="acard-img">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Alpet">
          <span class="acard-cat">Hiking</span>
          <button class="acard-fav" onclick="toggleFav(this)">🤍</button>
          <div class="acard-stars">★ 4.9 (128)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="acard-body">
          <div class="acard-meta"><span>📍 Shkodër</span><div class="dot3"></div><span>⏱ 6 orë</span><div class="dot3"></div><span>🏔️ Mesatar</span></div>

          </div>
        </div>

          <span class="acard-cat">Plazh</span>
          <button class="acard-fav" onclick="toggleFav(this)">🤍</button>
          <div class="acard-stars">★ 4.8 (94)</div>
        </div>

      <div class="acard fi-el" data-cat="kulture" data-dest="berat">
        <div class="acard-img">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Berat">
          <span class="acard-cat">Kulturë</span>
          <button class="acard-fav" onclick="toggleFav(this)">🤍</button>
          <div class="acard-stars">★ 4.9 (212)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="acard-body">
          <div class="acard-meta"><span>📍 Berat</span><div class="dot3"></div><span>⏱ 5 orë</span><div class="dot3"></div><span>🏛️ Çdo moshë</span></div>
          <h3 class="acard-title">Berat — Qyteti i Njëmijë Dritareve</h3>
          <p class="acard-desc">Trashëgimi UNESCO me 2,400 vjet histori. Kalaja, Lagja Mangalem, Kisha e Shën Mërisë dhe Muzeu Onufri. Darkë tradicionale.</p>
          <div class="acard-tags"><span class="atag">UNESCO</span><span class="atag">Darkë Tradicionale</span><span class="atag">Verë Lokale</span></div>
          <div class="acard-foot">
            <div class="acard-price">800 LEK <span>/ person</span></div>
            <button class="acard-book" onclick="openModal()">Rezervo</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="acard fi-el" data-cat="aventure" data-dest="permet">
        <div class="acard-img">
          <img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1530866495561-507c9faab2ed?w=700&q=85" alt="Rafting Vjosa">
          <span class="acard-cat">Aventurë</span>
          <button class="acard-fav" onclick="toggleFav(this)">🤍</button>
          <div class="acard-stars">★ 5.0 (67)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="acard-body">

    </a>

        <option>Paketa 2 Ditë Bjeshkë</option>
      </select>
      <input type="date" class="fi" style="width:100%" id="m-date">
      <button class="fsub" onclick="submitForm()">📩 Dërgoni Kërkesën</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// USER STORAGE (simulated, in-memory + localStorage)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
let users = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('fj_users') || '[]');
let currentUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('fj_current') || 'null');

// Email validation — RFC 5322 simplified
function isValidEmail(email) {
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(email.trim());
}

// Password strength
function checkPwStrength(pw) {
  const bar = document.getElementById('pw-bar');
  const hint = document.getElementById('pw-hint');
  if (!pw) { bar.className = 'pw-strength'; hint.textContent = 'Shkruani fjalëkalimin...'; return; }
  if (pw.length < 6) { bar.className = 'pw-strength pw-weak'; hint.textContent = '⚠ Shumë i shkurtër (min. 8 karaktere)'; return; }
  const hasUpper = /[A-Z]/.test(pw);
  const hasNum   = /[0-9]/.test(pw);
  const hasSpec  = /[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(pw);
  const score    = (pw.length >= 8 ? 1 : 0) + (hasUpper ? 1 : 0) + (hasNum ? 1 : 0) + (hasSpec ? 1 : 0);
  if (score <= 2) { bar.className = 'pw-strength pw-weak';   hint.textContent = '⚠ Fjalëkalim i dobët'; }
  else if (score === 3) { bar.className = 'pw-strength pw-medium'; hint.textContent = '✓ Fjalëkalim mesatar'; }
  else { bar.className = 'pw-strength pw-strong';  hint.textContent = '✓✓ Fjalëkalim i fortë!'; }
}

// Switch between Login / Register tabs
function switchTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.ltab').forEach((t,i) => t.classList.toggle('active', (i === 0) === (tab === 'login')));
  document.getElementById('form-login').style.display    = tab === 'login'    ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('form-register').style.display = tab === 'register' ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('login-err').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('reg-err').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('reg-ok').classList.remove('show');
}

// ── LOGIN ──
function doLogin() {
  const email = document.getElementById('l-email').value.trim();
  const pass  = document.getElementById('l-pass').value;
  const err   = document.getElementById('login-err');

  // Validate email format
  if (!isValidEmail(email)) {
    document.getElementById('l-email').classList.add('error');
    err.textContent = '⚠ Ju lutem shkruani një adresë email të vlefshme (p.sh. emri@domain.al)';
    err.classList.add('show'); return;
  }
  document.getElementById('l-email').classList.remove('error');

  if (!pass) {
    err.textContent = '⚠ Ju lutem shkruani fjalëkalimin.';
    err.classList.add('show'); return;
  }

  // Check credentials
  const user = users.find(u => u.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase() && u.pass === pass);
  if (!user) {
    err.textContent = '⚠ Email ose fjalëkalimi nuk është i saktë. Nuk keni llogari? Shkoni tek "Regjistrim".';
    err.classList.add('show'); return;
  }

  err.classList.remove('show');
  loginSuccess(user);
}

// ── REGISTER ──
function doRegister() {
  const name   = document.getElementById('r-name').value.trim();
  const email  = document.getElementById('r-email').value.trim();
  const pass   = document.getElementById('r-pass').value;
  const pass2  = document.getElementById('r-pass2').value;
  const err    = document.getElementById('reg-err');
  const ok     = document.getElementById('reg-ok');

  err.classList.remove('show');
  ok.classList.remove('show');

  if (!name || name.length < 3) {
    err.textContent = '⚠ Ju lutem shkruani emrin tuaj të plotë (min. 3 karaktere).';
    err.classList.add('show'); return;
  }

  if (!isValidEmail(email)) {
    document.getElementById('r-email').classList.add('error');
    err.textContent = '⚠ Adresa email nuk është e vlefshme. Format: emri@domain.al';
    err.classList.add('show'); return;
  }
  document.getElementById('r-email').classList.remove('error');

  // Check if email already exists
  if (users.find(u => u.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase())) {
    err.textContent = '⚠ Ky email është i regjistruar tashmë. Hyni me llogarinë ekzistuese.';
    err.classList.add('show'); return;
  }

  if (pass.length < 8) {
    err.textContent = '⚠ Fjalëkalimi duhet të ketë minimum 8 karaktere.';
    err.classList.add('show'); return;
  }

  if (pass !== pass2) {
    err.textContent = '⚠ Fjalëkalimet nuk përputhen. Kontrolloni dhe provoni përsëri.';
    err.classList.add('show'); return;
  }

  // Save new user
  const newUser = { name, email, pass, joined: new Date().toLocaleDateString('sq-AL') };
  users.push(newUser);
  localStorage.setItem('fj_users', JSON.stringify(users));

  ok.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(() => { switchTab('login'); document.getElementById('l-email').value = email; }, 2000);
}

// ── SUCCESS ──
function loginSuccess(user) {
  currentUser = user;
  localStorage.setItem('fj_current', JSON.stringify(user));

  // Update UI
  const initials = user.name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0,2);
  const firstName = user.name.split(' ')[0];
  document.getElementById('nav-avatar').textContent    = initials;
  document.getElementById('nav-username').textContent  = firstName;
  document.getElementById('user-name-banner').textContent = firstName;

  // Show site, hide login
  document.getElementById('login-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('main-site').style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('info-banner').classList.add('show');
}

// ── LOGOUT ──
function doLogout() {
  currentUser = null;
  localStorage.removeItem('fj_current');
  document.getElementById('login-overlay').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('main-site').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('info-banner').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('l-email').value = '';
  document.getElementById('l-pass').value  = '';
}

// ── AUTO LOGIN if session exists ──
if (currentUser) { loginSuccess(currentUser); }

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// MODAL
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function openModal()   { document.getElementById('modal').classList.add('open') }
function closeModal()  { document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('open') }
function closeOuter(e) { if (e.target === document.getElementById('modal')) closeModal() }
function submitForm()  {
  closeModal();
  alert('✅ Faleminderit! Kërkesa u dërgua.\nDo ju kontaktojmë brenda 2 orëve.\n\n📞 069 430 2957\n✉ amandagalliu@gmail.com');
}
function submitContact() {
  alert('✅ Mesazhi u dërgua!\nDo ju kontaktojmë brenda 2 orëve.\n\n📞 069 430 2957\n✉ amandagalliu@gmail.com');
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// FILTERS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function toggleFav(btn) { btn.textContent = btn.textContent === '🤍' ? '❤️' : '🤍' }

function filterPill(btn, cat) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('#cards-grid .acard').forEach(c => {
    c.style.display = (cat === '' || c.dataset.cat.includes(cat)) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

function filterCards() {
  const dest = document.getElementById('sel-dest').value;
  const cat  = document.getElementById('sel-cat').value;
  let found  = 0;
  document.querySelectorAll('#cards-grid .acard').forEach(c => {
    const ok = (!dest || c.dataset.dest === dest) && (!cat || c.dataset.cat.includes(cat));
    c.style.display = ok ? '' : 'none';
    if (ok) found++;
  });
  if (!found) {
    document.querySelectorAll('#cards-grid .acard').forEach(c => c.style.display = '');
    alert('Nuk u gjet asnjë aktivitet.\n\nNdihmë: 📞 069 430 2957');
  }
}

function subscribe() {
  const e = document.getElementById('nl-email');
  if (!e.value || !isValidEmail(e.value)) { alert('Shkruani email të vlefshëm!'); return; }
  document.getElementById('nl-msg').style.display = 'block';
  e.value = '';
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// SCROLL ANIMATIONS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  entries.forEach((en, i) => {
    if (en.isIntersecting) setTimeout(() => en.target.classList.add('vis'), i * 70);
  });
}, { threshold: 0.08 });
document.querySelectorAll('.fi-el').forEach(el => obs.observe(el));

// Card click → modal
document.querySelectorAll('.acard').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (e.target.classList.contains('acard-fav') || e.target.closest('.acard-fav') || e.target.classList.contains('acard-book')) return;
    openModal();
  });
});

// Set dates
const today = new Date();
['sel-date','f-date','m-date'].forEach(id => {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.valueAsDate = today;
});

// Enter key on login
document.getElementById('l-pass').addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') doLogin(); });
document.getElementById('l-email').addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') doLogin(); });
</script>
</body>
